# Aria Black Car Service

> Premium black car and chauffeur service in New York City and the tri-state area. Flat-rate airport transfers, corporate travel, hourly hire, and special events. TLC licensed. 24/7. No surge pricing.

Website: https://ariablackcarservice.com
Phone: (888) 402-8202
Email: info@ariablackcarservice.com

## Services

- Airport transfers: JFK, LaGuardia, Newark, Teterboro, Westchester
- Hourly chauffeur from $90/hr
- Corporate accounts and executive travel
- Weddings, events, long-distance (Boston, Hamptons, DC, Philadelphia)

## Airport flat rates (Manhattan, sedan/SUV)

- JFK: $165 / $250
- LaGuardia: $140 / $220
- Newark: $180 / $275
